reuse.why: Routes every server-side expected-amount site and the API model through the existing exported getScheduledAmount, and uses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold for the approximate tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint/missing-amount dispatches and adds none.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where getScheduledAmount already was; the API field is computed in api-models' scheduleModel.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, the API field and tests.

maintainability.why: One definition for the rule, but the op is a third positional argument after a boolean (callers pass 'false' explicitly), desktop-client callers omit op so approximate amounts are not worst-cased there, and one comment still says 'furthest from zero'.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains; the inline copies were replaced by calls.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an optional positional 'op' string and an isapprox branch; existing desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list, useScheduleEdit) call it without op and so apply a different rule for approximate amounts.
